name: Ring of Blinking
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 168, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura moderate transmutation CL 7th
Slot ring; Price 27,000 gp; Weight —
Description
On command, this ring makes the wearer blink, as the blink spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, blink; Cost 13,500 gp
